name: 40891-longdecode-0.6b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process engine (guidellm `vllm_python`), no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=192, warmup one fresh batch of 192 requests, bounded at 768 requests, safety cap 1800 s.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, exactly 256 prompt tokens and 2048 output tokens (min = max, no variance), prompts drawn independently, prefix caching off, ignore_eos so every request emits its full 2048, seed 1. The backend applies the chat template, so the engine's own prompt-token count reads a handful above 256.
purpose: A compact creative-writing assistant generating long 2000-word drafts from short prompts for 192 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen3-0.6B
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16

# Pinned, not defaults left standing: the engine is driven in-process, a usage context this
# commit's batch-size defaults table does not cover, so an unpinned engine falls to 2048 batched
# tokens and 128 sequences -- and 128 would silently cap the running batch below the declared
# concurrency.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
max-num-seqs: 1024

enable-prefix-caching: false
max-model-len: 4096
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
